createenchantablemachinery.ponder.mechan: Like other tool, Mechanical Drill can be enchanted by enchanting table or anvil
Efficiency enchantments can increase the mining speed of mechanical drills...
Silk touch mining can also be used
Mechanical Drill can grant any enchantment for mining tools
When wearing Engineers' Goggles, the player can get drill's enchantments
Like other tool, Mechanical Saw can be enchanted by enchanting table or anvil
Efficiency enchantments can increase the processing efficiency of items
Of course, enchantments can also be applied to logging.
Using a mechanical saw with a silk touch...
The effect of enchantment allows you to cut down trees.
Mechanical Saw can grant any enchantment for mining tools.
When wearing Engineers' Goggles, the player can get saw's enchantments.
createenchantablemachinery.ponder.encase: ケース入りファンには効率強化のエンチャントを付与することができます
効率強化が付与されたケース入りファンはアイテムをより早く加工することができます
